about: packages/topo/src/props.json: the topo story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: Real tissue on its glass slide drawn in H&E from cells alone: the healthy tile of 640 um round the poster's patch (945 cells) and the new slide's window of 1.5 mm (6,716 cells), plus sketches of other modalities (spots, multiplex), the fixed scales other tools read and an overview of the whole section.
sets.frame: Lies flat (x-z, y up), centred on the origin on a glass slide whose +x end shows past it.

params.name: slide_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: slide_show
params.meaning: what lies on the glass: 0 the healthy tile, 1 the new slide's window, 2 both side by side at one scale

params.name: slide_mode
params.meaning: the modality: 0 H&E, 1 spatial transcriptomics (sketch: the spots), 2 spatial proteomics (sketch: cells glowing by type on black); in between, the sweep's front running

params.name: slide_points
params.meaning: every cell becomes a glowing white-gold bead (TLOOK cells' bead morph), the ground dark glass with the tissue's ghost, the spots gone

params.name: slide_scale
params.meaning: chapter 2's fixed scales on the tile: 1 the grid of 100 µm squares with one lit ("one patch size"), 2 a cell and its six nearest joined ("a neighbour count"), 3 a 30 µm

params.name: slide_patch
params.meaning: the poster's patch marked on the tile: its square in amber with glowing corners

params.name: slide_over
params.meaning: the new slide's overview: 1 the whole section on its glass slide, the window marked (a cyan square); towards 0 it zooms into the window

data.text: Cell positions and types from the authors' GTEx liver cohort run by topocyte (HistoPLUS cell classes); drawn in H&E, never an image; slide ids never shown.

sets.notes: slide_mode and slide_points are plain params; slide_scale and slide_over are story-only. British spelling. Exports api (TW, layout, tile, win, overview, pos, hub, six, circle), textures, dispose.

sets.shows: The signal back on the tissue: one cell's 50 um neighbourhood and its own network, bars and score; every cell scored as a relief; the two groups (healthy-like, cirrhosis-like) as piles with shares; and sketches of the next steps (genes, proteins).
sets.frame: In the slide set's frame over the window (centred on the origin; side by side with slide_show 2 it moves to x 0.42).

params.name: map_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: map_cell
params.meaning: the dome on the cell, its cells lit, its complex, its bars and score (all of them fade with it, and with the split and the sketches)

params.name: map_r
params.meaning: the radius (µm) of its part of the complex: stored edges and triangles whose radius is at most it; also the balls' radius and the level on its tower

params.name: map_balls
params.meaning: the growing balls round its cells (glass discs, the union look of the tower's balls)

params.name: map_bars
params.meaning: the picked cell's own persistence bars rise behind it

params.name: map_score
params.meaning: its score's needle and tag

params.name: map_all
params.meaning: the sweeping dome and the relief behind it (0 none, 1 every cell risen; the dome goes from 0.92 on)

params.name: map_split
params.meaning: the cells fly to their piles (from the bottom up, a layer at a time; the relief folds away by 0.35)

params.name: map_omics
params.meaning: the sketches: 1 spots and the volcano, 2 the multiplex slide and protein columns; in between a crossfade (the cells settle back on the slide on the way to 1)

params.name: map_pick
params.meaning: the cell with the dome (an index into the window's cells; -1 the poster's cell v)

params.name: map_delta
params.meaning: the map at 50 µm (0) or 100 µm as in the poster's figure (1): the relief's and beads' colours (lo100, its own limit 13.51), the groups and piles

Proteins · sketch: the workflow, not data

data.text: Every cell's stored score at 50 and 100 um, the window's stored complex and bars, the groups from the scores' signs; relief heights are smoothed for drawing only. Cell v's score 6.97 is the data's (the poster prints 26.57: open question T5).

sets.notes: map_pick, map_delta are steps; map_omics may be stepped. Nothing scientific is computed here. Exports api (n, e, drawR, eLogOdds, limit50, limit100, delta, comp50, comp100, types, cell, counts, pos, pick).

sets.shows: The poster's patch of 110 real cells with glass balls growing round them, edges and triangles appearing, pieces joining and loops opening and closing, then the tower of scales and its barcode.
sets.frame: The patch lies on a glass plate with its frosted label towards you, the poster's y running away (-z); the tower rises from it.
sets.size: plate 1.5 wide; tower 1.68 units with the trunk

params.name: tower_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: tower_r
params.meaning: the radius in µm (1.5 to 60; up to 120 is drawn)

params.name: tower_rise
params.meaning: 0 everything on the plate; 1 the tower of scales (heights times this)

params.name: tower_bars
params.meaning: the rods fly out to the board (0.04 to 0.58), the glass board (0.3 to 0.6), the two curves drawing upwards (0.5 to 1)

params.name: tower_he
params.meaning: 1: the 110 cells in H&E by their types (looked up in the healthy tile by position), on a pale eosin stain; to 0 they shrink into beads

params.name: tower_lit
params.meaning: 0 both, 1 pieces lit (loops dimmed), 2 loops lit (pieces dimmed)

One piece · 2 loops: the big one still open
One piece · no loops: the big one has filled
The big loop · a chimney from birth to filling

data.text: The poster's patch: 110 cells in a 214 um window, 313 edges, 204 triangles, 109 joinings, 85 loops, all topocyte's and gudhi's.

sets.notes: The radius eases on the poster's log ruler (tower.log, topo's LOG set). In a headset it stands about 1.55 m tall (stand view; the up view is screens only). tower_lit is a step. Exports api (range, ticks, snaps, counts, lanes, cells, loops, main, piece, loop, bar, pick), log.

sets.shows: The 123 slides as a rack of glass slides with their curves (66 healthy, 57 cirrhotic), the classes' means, the main shapes, the cube of scores, the classifier's wall with its held-out stacks, and the weight for every radius on a column of radii with windows and a gap.
sets.frame: Rack of slides in two rows stepping up towards the back; weights column at x 2.05; cube of scores 1.6 across.
sets.size: rack plus a weights column out to x ~2.05; cube of scores 1.6 across

params.name: cohort_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: cohort_dim
params.meaning: 1 loops (h1, the poster's), 0 pieces (h0): curves, means, shapes, scores, wall, log-odds, stacks, γ, windows and gap all switch

params.name: cohort_rack
params.meaning: the slides drop into their slots (0 to 0.14, front to back), then their curves light one after another by slide number (0.14 to 0.94, each with a flash)

params.name: cohort_means
params.meaning: the classes' mean curves in front of their rows; the slides' curves dim a little

params.name: cohort_shapes
params.meaning: the two main shapes hovering over the rack, their shares as tags

params.name: cohort_space
params.meaning: the slides fly into the cube of their scores (staggered over 0.03 to 0.98 by slide number); the shapes move onto its edges, the rack fades

params.name: cohort_wall
params.meaning: the classifier's wall sweeps in to its place (in by 0.8)

params.name: cohort_odds
params.meaning: the slides glide to their log-odds along the axis through the wall

params.name: cohort_stacks
params.meaning: the slides drop into the four stacks (from wherever they are; the tallest stack's last slide lands at 0.94)

params.name: cohort_gamma
params.meaning: the column rises (0 to 0.3), γ draws upwards (0.2 to 0.55), the means (0.4 to 0.7), the windows' bands (0.65 to 0.95)

params.name: cohort_gap
params.meaning: the bands drop into the gap's stack (0 to 0.74, one after another), its ring and tag (0.6 to 0.9)

params.name: cohort_win
params.meaning: a window of radii chosen in explore: a cyan band round the column from cohort_from to cohort_to, with its share and odds factor as a tag; the poster's bands dim

params.name: cohort_from
params.meaning: the window in µm, rounded to the 0.5 µm grid of the stored shares (0 to 100; cohort_to 100.5 or more means "and above")

params.name: cohort_to
params.meaning: the window in µm, rounded to the 0.5 µm grid of the stored shares (0 to 100; cohort_to 100.5 or more means "and above")

params.name: cohort_pick
params.meaning: a picked slide (0..122, -1 none): its curve lit cyan in the rack, a glow in the cloud, pulled out of its stack towards you; the others dim and the set's other tags hide

Weight per radius · red speaks for cirrhosis

data.text: Everything is topocyte's, from TOPO_DATA.h1 (loops) or h0 (pieces): curves, scores, coefficients, held-out predictions; the set only places stored numbers and sums stored shares.

sets.notes: cohort_dim and cohort_pick are steps; cohort_from and cohort_to are plain numbers on the 0.5 um grid. Cheap (8 ms). Exports api (n, healthy, cirrhosis, slide, fve, accuracy, confusion, window, windows, gap, grid, pick, mid).
